# The top bar's highlight at Bar sizes other than 100%, fix/review150 (1280x720, GUI scale 3 = 427x240; the demo song,
# paused on a line so the pictures hold still; Font: Minecraft, where the highlight's round ends show best).
# Run it on the branch, and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/review150 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/review150.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/review150 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/review150.txt
# (and the same two with -f version=1.21.1: its clip box is worked out by the mod, TopBarLayout.scaledClip, not the game).
#
# Paused on "Every word is written in the stars" with "the stars" on the violet highlight (as bar133-pixel-last): the
# pill is sized to the line, so the last word's highlight ends exactly at the end of the text's room, where the clip box
# ends. The game scales that box with the bar and rounds its left edge and its width down to whole GUI units.
#   review150-size100: Bar size 100%: both ends round, the same on both (batch 101's fix; nothing changed here).
#   review150-size130, review150-size95, review150-size115: old code: the highlight's right end is cut straight up and
#     down, about 2 to 3.5 screen pixels of its round end missing (worked out for this pill; the exact amount depends on
#     where the eased pill sits, so one of the three may show less). Branch: the right end round in all three.
#   review150-size75: the smallest bar, old code about 0.7 pixel cut (may not show); branch round.
#   The log's "barprobe clip left= right=" are in the bar's own units (before the size): the branch's right is the
#     old one (303 in bar133) or one to three more; it must stay left of the equaliser's bars in every picture.
# Also look that no word of the line shows under the equaliser at 130% (the clip may reach up to 2 units further right).

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
look 0 -20
guiscale 3
sleep 8

set smoothFont false
music pause
sleep 1
seek 27.6
sleep 2
where
shot review150-size100
barprobe
sleep 1
set barSize 1.3
sleep 2
shot review150-size130
barprobe
sleep 1
set barSize 0.95
sleep 2
shot review150-size95
barprobe
sleep 1
set barSize 1.15
sleep 2
shot review150-size115
barprobe
sleep 1
set barSize 0.75
sleep 2
shot review150-size75
barprobe
sleep 1
set barSize 1
